shared_elements: low relief carved on pale stone slab/upright block
bird head in profile with pointed beak
horizontal band of repeated units running across the top above the figural field
object with an arched handle (bucket/bag shape)
profile figures with clearly outlined limbs
justification: Both put a horizontal register of small repeated units across the top edge and a larger profile bird-headed creature with an arched-handled bag/bucket shape in the main field below, which is a fairly specific coincidence of layout and motif. But the rendering is entirely different in competence and manner: A is deeply modelled, densely detailed and symmetrically composed around a formal plant, while B is shallow, flat, sketch-like and irregularly scattered over an unsquared block.
